admission.justification: Prevents an operator from assuming an untyped membership-removal edit is executable when the only command is needed to retain sprint identity.

applicability: Retire/finalize refusal guidance for removing a master from a commanding sprint.
conditions: The remedy is selected from the actual typed-row and retained-sprint shape.
An admitted untyped edit includes any required graph and integration-branch changes.
exclusions: The sole untyped-master/no-retirement shape has no removal edit; the command is retained rather than advertising an impossible action.

evidence: notes/reports/role-launch/260928-MIK-L41-reviewer-acd0dccb-066d-41e9-ab45-b3d7e19e742f.md section 'Sealed findings 3 to 8'; probes x14_reattach_untyped.out and x31_named_edit_and_member.out part A (the named edit carried out as written, then the recorded request completes); two killed mutations under sealed id 3

statement: Membership-removal guidance names detach_master for a typed row, an admitted set_field edit for an untyped membership when another commanded master or a retirement record preserves sprint identity, and explicitly reports no available removal edit for a sole untyped master without a retirement record.
